title: 5d-6: review integration — violations + diffing + waivers
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to build

Wire the constraint system into the review pipeline. Enrich `ConstraintViolation` with full context (kind, severity, provenance, component). Replace the ad-hoc `query_forbidden_deps` call in `build_findings` with the DD maintained violation view. Add constraint diffing — report which violations the current change introduces vs resolves. Partition waived constraint violations (same pattern as convention waivers).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Richer `ConstraintViolation` with full context
- [ ] Constraint diffing (introduced vs resolved)
- [ ] Waiver partition in review
- [ ] Uses DD maintained view (not ad-hoc)
- [ ] Parallel structure with convention violation handling

## Blocked by

- sutra/71 — 5d-3: DD forbidden pairs maintained view
- sutra/73 — 5d-5: constraint waivers (DB)

acceptance_criteria.text: [x] ConstraintViolation enriched with constraint_id, constraint_name, constraint_kind, severity, provenance, component_context
[x] Review output shows constraint violations with full context — no re-join against constraint store needed
[x] Review shows violation delta: violations introduced by the change vs violations resolved
[x] Constraint waivers partitioned in review — waived violations shown separately with rationale
[x] ReviewFindings struct extended with constraint waiver data
[x] Follows same waiver-partition pattern as convention violations in build_findings
[x] build_findings uses the DD maintained violation view instead of ad-hoc query_forbidden_deps

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial, scope: 50a59cd..74bd52e):

Verdict: needs-attention

Findings hitting this task:
1. [high] Review cannot report resolved constraint violations (review.rs:258-288) — delta logic only iterates current_violations, resolved violations are never emitted. Fails the review delta contract.
2. [medium] Constraint waivers match too broadly (review.rs:325-332) — waiver matches on constraint_id + either endpoint file, ignoring symbol_qualified_name. Not parallel to convention waiver pattern which scopes by convention + symbol/component.
3. [high] Shared DD engines reused without freshness check (constraints.rs:131-136) — cross-cutting, affects review/orient/MCP/guard.
